test_title: PYST 05: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 11 Dec 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.

The father said, “Ramu, try again”.

options.text: The father said that Ramu tries again.
The father advised Ramu to try again
The father told Ramu that he tried again.
The father requested Ramu to try again.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Direct Speech:** The father said, “Ramu, try again”.
 
• **Indirect Speech:** The father advised Ramu to try again.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **The imperative sentence "Try again" changes into "to try again" in indirect speech.**
 
 
• The verb "said" changes to "advised" since the sentence conveys a suggestion.
 
• The pronoun remains the same.
 
• The quotation marks are removed.
 
 
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *The father advised Ramu to try again.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "The father said that Ramu tries again." 

 
 
• Incorrect because "tries" is in the present tense, which does not match the reported speech rules.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "The father told Ramu that he tried again." 
 
 
• Incorrect because "told" is not the correct reporting verb for advice, and "he tried again" alters the meaning.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "The father requested Ramu to try again." 
 
 
• Incorrect because "requested" is used when making polite or formal requests, not giving advice.
